data.name: Galactic Empire
data.detailed_description:
Galactic Empire

Build your own galactic empire and lead it to domination among the stars.

In Galactic Empire, every turn matters. You will expand your infrastructure, research new technologies, build and upgrade your fleet, manage diplomacy and trade, defend your worlds, and conquer new systems. Every decision shapes the future of your empire.

Choose your path

At the beginning of the game you choose:

Planet type

Each starting planet has unique traits such as resource richness, food abundance, temperature, buildable space, population size, and sometimes unique structures. Your starting world directly influences your strategy.

Character class

  • Architect – cheaper and faster construction

  • Scientist – stronger research and technological development

  • General – superior military power and fleet efficiency

Each class changes your playstyle and provides unique bonuses. Additional specializations can be unlocked later in the game.

Define your victory

Choose one or more victory conditions:

  • technological supremacy

  • maximum reputation among factions

  • conquest of all planets

  • reaching a target score

Develop your empire

Build structures, conduct research, and construct fleets. Unlock new technologies and blueprints that expand your strategic options and change how you play.

Population management

Your empire consists of four social classes:

  • unemployed

  • workers

  • engineers

  • administrators

Assign them wisely to ensure efficient growth, production, and stability.

Ships and customization

Every ship contains upgrade slots for parts. These components allow you to fully customize your fleet, creating units specialized for economy, defense, or full-scale warfare.

A living galaxy

Explore a massive procedural universe:

  • multiple galaxies and star systems

  • planets, black holes, nebulae

  • cantinas, asteroid fields, pirate hideouts

Send probes, scout locations, and decide how to use what you discover.

Diplomacy and factions

Your actions affect your reputation with other factions. Some will become allies and trade partners, while others will declare war and try to destroy your empire.

Warfare and defense

Build defensive systems and manage them during enemy attacks. Engage in turn-based battles and fight for control over the galaxy.

Additional systems

  • original card game available in cantinas, with deck progression

  • laws that periodically change gameplay conditions

  • achievement system and global rankings

  • tutorials and beginner-friendly missions

  • four difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Hard, Extreme

  • over 40 minutes of original soundtrack

  • OS *: 64-bit Windows 7 or higher
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with 512MB VRAM
